summary: Start a thread with t or Shift+T, and show every thread keycap in lowercase

replay.detail: Key handling and rendering only; no durable data is replayed.

schema.detail: No wire or storage schema changes.

rules.detail: Thread access rules are unchanged. Existing bindings keep working: t, and z/n/p/v/r in either case.

compatibility.detail: Clients and daemons interoperate as before.

manual.detail: On an Inbox item with a writable connection, the Start thread button shows t, and both t and Shift+T open the first-message box. Thread action buttons show z, n, p, v and r, matching the footer and help.
